values.note: All bookings by call or text (8 am-8 pm daily); drop-ins are taken if a site is free. Book at 21 or older with photo ID and signed policies. Stays under 30 nights are paid in full 14 days ahead; cancellations by phone only (full refund less $20 more than 14 days out, half refund less $20 at 7-14 days). Check-in 3-5 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://cccamp.us/rv-sites-1 ('At this time all reservations are made by call or text', 'If you don't have a reservation and are on the road, please don't hesitate to call. If we can fit you in, we will.') + https://cccamp.us/quick-stays ('All booking is done by phone at this time', 'Call 8am to 8 pm / 7 days a week') + https://cccamp.us/policies (check-in/out, payment and refund terms), read 2026-11-23

note: Small wooded campground right off US 150 at Crab Orchard (the red-roof barn), about a mile from Cedar Creek Lake; also cabins, vintage campers and month-to-month stays. At most 4 adults and one vehicle per site; tents only where designated. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $49/night (up to 6 nights), $289/week, monthly $650-745, phone/text booking. Added sewer at some sites, WiFi, dump, flush toilets, veterans/military discount, booking terms.
